IssuerLabel.name: Issuer Label
IssuerLabel.definition: Number of the resolution as specified by the issuer or its agent.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Language, title and textual description of an agenda resolution.

SubStatus.name: Sub Status
SubStatus.definition: Specifies whether the resolution is a new or an amended resolution.

For.name: For
For.definition: Number of securities for which vote in favour is instructed.

Against.name: Against
Against.definition: Number of securities for which vote against is instructed.

Abstain.name: Abstain
Abstain.definition: Number of securities for which vote to abstain is instructed.

Withhold.name: Withhold
Withhold.definition: Number of securities for which vote to withhold is instructed.

WithManagement.name: With Management
WithManagement.definition: Number of securities for which vote in line with the votes of the management is instructed.

AgainstManagement.name: Against Management
AgainstManagement.definition: Number of securities for which vote against the voting recommendation of the management is instructed.

Discretionary.name: Discretionary
Discretionary.definition: Number of securities for which decision is left to the party that will exercise the voting right.

OneYear.name: One Year
OneYear.definition: Number of securities for which vote in favour for one year for 'say on pay' type of resolution is instructed.

TwoYears.name: Two Years
TwoYears.definition: Number of securities for which vote in favour of two years for 'say on pay' type of resolution is instructed.

ThreeYears.name: Three Years
ThreeYears.definition: Number of securities for which vote in favour of three years for 'say on pay' type of resolution is instructed.

NoAction.name: No Action
NoAction.definition: Number of votes for which no action has been taken.

Blank.name: Blank
Blank.definition: Vote is cast as empty but the vote is counted.

Proprietary.name: Proprietary
Proprietary.definition: Other type of vote expressed as a proprietary code.

Withdrawn.name: Withdrawn
Withdrawn.definition: Indicates the resolution was withdrawn at the meeting.
